voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: The lift stops with the dignity of a machine hoping nobody heard that. Welcome to the Underworld.
voices.learningIntent: Introduce warm industrial adventure without technical claims
voices.scope: Actual existing game use documented
voices.listenFor: Follow the little pause before the welcome and the dry emphasis on the lift’s dignity.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: Choose Look to inspect the power indication. Then inspect the separate link indication.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for the second instruction to inspect the separate link indication after checking power.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: A lit power lamp tells you about power. It does not, by itself, tell you that a communication link works.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check that “by itself” stays audible between the two clauses about power and communication.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: Walk, Look, Talk and Use have labeled controls. You can explore with the keyboard, too.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen to the four verb names. Use should end with a voiced z sound.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: This lab highlights the bytes four E and five one inside a larger supplied frame. They are our known test pattern.
voices.learningIntent: AC21; spoken hexadecimal read as separate characters; not full frame
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Follow both byte names, four E and five one, and the phrase locating them inside the larger frame.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: Here, the upper layers supply context. The activity simulates only the declared physical path.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check that the limitation “only the declared physical path” survives the turn from context to simulation.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: This fictional copper profile permits one hundred metres. Count the whole declared path before you choose.
voices.learningIntent: T01/T02; explicitly fictional profile and unit
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for “fictional”, “one hundred metres” and the instruction to count the whole path.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: The signal can be regenerated on an intact section. The gap in the cable remains a gap.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for the distinction between an intact section and a gap, including the final repeated word.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: Compare the received level with both receiver bounds, then check the required reserve margin.
voices.learningIntent: T04/T05/T06/T15; lower and upper limits plus margin
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check that both receiver bounds and the reserve margin sound like distinct checks.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: Signal and noise are separate observations. Compare them, change the declared condition, and measure again.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Follow signal and noise separately, then listen for the instruction to change the condition before measuring again.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: Take your time. This toy symbol exercise advances when you choose a step, not when a clock runs out.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for an unhurried invitation to choose a step, with the clock mentioned only at the end.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: Four symbols represent eight bits in this toy example. That does not tell us a useful data rate.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check that four symbols, eight bits and useful data rate remain distinct.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: The Backhoe of Doom has uncovered a fault with extraordinary thoroughness. You may prefer a smaller tool.
voices.learningIntent: Warm failure reaction; no technical success implied
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen to the Backhoe of Doom punch line and the quiet turn toward a smaller tool.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: Retry returns you to preparation. Your new clues, notes and hint history remain, and the old attempt measurements become stale.
voices.learningIntent: NQ-08; exact retry retention, no implicit save
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check the list of retained clues, notes and hint history against the final phrase about stale measurements.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: The Steady Light: the permanent route passed its declared checks. The maintenance record remembers how you got here.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for the ending title, the permanent route, and the scope of its declared checks.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: The Borrowed Dawn: service is restored through a temporary route. Its limitation and the next repair belong in the record.
voices.learningIntent: E02 / LO6; temporary success remains temporary
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for the ending title and the word temporary, then the landing on the repair record.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: The Honest Shutdown: the unsafe path is isolated. The service is still unresolved, and your recovery plan says so.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Follow the change from isolation to unresolved service and the stated recovery plan.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.caption: The Iron City is the next realm. This episode ends here; your return path remains available.
voices.learningIntent: C3 / NQ-12; future boundary and return
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check that the Iron City and the end of this episode are distinct from the available return path.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: Bring me an observation, a question, and a willingness to change your mind. The enormous hammer is optional.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Hear Titan give the invitation to reconsider before the aside about the hammer.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: For this investigation, these endpoints are known good. We are testing the physical path between them.
voices.learningIntent: O02; declared scope, not global claim
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for the qualification “for this investigation” before the known-good endpoints and the path between them.
